Appointment orders will be issued by the respective Ministry. || Stage 1 - Application Scrutiny and Shortlisting || All applications are scrutinized for eligibility. If applications are large in number, UPSC may shortlist based on: (a) Desirable Qualifications; (b) higher educational qualifications; (c) higher relevant experience; (d) counting experience before/after essential qualification; (e) invoking experience even where not mentioned as EQ/DQ; or (f) by holding a Recruitment Test. Candidates should mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum qualifications. || Stage 2 - Recruitment Test (RT) followed by Interview (wherever applicable) || If selection is made by Recruitment Test followed by Interview, candidates must achieve minimum suitability at both stages. Minimum interview marks: UR – 50, OBC – 45, SC/ST/PH – 40 (out of 100 total interview marks). Minimum marks for Recruitment Test shall be decided by UPSC on a case-by-case basis. || Stage 3 - Medical Examination || Selected candidates must be in sound bodily health and must undergo medical examination and satisfy medical authority as required by the Government.
